description: This file contains unit tests for activation repartitioning, specifically testing a frequency filter that uses a Zipf distribution sampler. It includes test classes, a custom key struct, a collection class, and a Zipf distribution sampler implementation.

classes.name: TestKey
classes.description: A struct representing a key with a ulong value, providing a static method to generate the next key.

classes.name: UlongFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A sealed class extending FrequentItemCollection for ulong keys, with a method to remove items.

classes.name: FastZipf
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate Zipf-distributed samples efficiently.

classes.name: ZipfRejectionSampler
classes.description: A class implementing rejection sampling for the Zipf distribution.

methods.name: GetExpectedTopK
methods.description: A unit test method that generates samples from a Zipf distribution, updates a collection, and verifies the output is not empty.

methods.name: TestKey
methods.description: A struct with a ulong key, a static method to get the next key, and an override for ToString.

methods.name: UlongFrequentItemCollection
methods.description: A collection class for ulong items with a remove method.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Static methods to generate Zipf-distributed samples, either with a provided Random or a seeded static instance.

methods.name: Sample
methods.description: Method in ZipfRejectionSampler that performs rejection sampling to generate a Zipf-distributed value.

methods.name: bInvCdf
methods.description: Private method in ZipfRejectionSampler that computes the inverse CDF for sampling.
